about: Real-manuscript evaluation corpus for the knockout-control reasoning gate. Each case is a REAL antibody-validation scenario drawn from an open-access published paper (real PMID + DOI cited). To stay copyright-clean and free of PMC full-text extraction artifacts, the 'methods' text is a FAITHFUL PARAPHRASE of each paper's reported approach — NOT a verbatim quote — but the antibody, target, validation approach, and label reflect what the cited paper actually reports (verifiable by looking up the PMID). Labels: validated = an in-study GENETIC control (knockout/knockdown/CRISPR/siRNA) shows the signal is LOST for the antibody's own target; ambiguous = validation is claimed/implied but is not a clean in-study genetic pass (peptide/pre-adsorption, recombinant-protein, overexpression, cited-prior, manufacturer, cross-antibody concordance, OR a genetic control that did NOT abolish the signal); not_reported = the antibody is used with no specificity validation described. 'hard' marks genuinely debatable cases (e.g. a knockout run but signal not lost) where an expert could reasonably choose an adjacent label. Sources: 6 open-access papers (PMIDs 38761203, 34085120, 40025338, 39955330, 30679523, 26998240). Cite PubMed.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: The RD4 antibody (Millipore) was used to detect 4R Tau. Selectivity was confirmed by immunolabelling wildtype versus Tau-knockout (Mapt-/-) mouse brain sections, with immunoreactivity absent in the knockout tissue.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: The oligomeric-Tau antibody T22 was applied by western blot; T22-immunoreactive bands were absent in Tau-knockout (Mapt-/-) mouse brain lysates, supporting its selectivity for Tau in mouse samples.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: The rabbit anti-KOR antibody PA847p was validated by immunoblot: the KOR-specific ~55 kDa and ~45 kDa bands seen in wildtype mouse brain were absent in KOR-knockout mouse brain.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: The phospho-KOR antibody anti-pS369 gave no staining in KOR-knockout mouse brain after either saline or U50,488H agonist treatment, indicating specificity for phosphorylated KOR.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: The anti-Ntrk1 antibody 06-574 (Millipore) was tested by western blot against Ntrk1 CRISPR-knockout embryonic brain lysate; several bands disappeared in the knockout sample, indicating they represented Ntrk1.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: The rat monoclonal anti-GABARAP antibody 8H5 gave only weak background staining in GABARAP-knockout cells (which still express the other ATG8 family members), confirming its selectivity for GABARAP by immunofluorescence.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: The anti-AKT1 antibody (Proteintech 10176-2-AP) was validated by siRNA knockdown of AKT1 in HEK293 cells; the signal dropped significantly in AKT1-siRNA-treated cells relative to control siRNA.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The pSer262 Tau antibody (Abcam) was characterised against recombinant Tau phosphorylated in vitro by defined kinases; it failed to detect CAMKII-phosphorylated Tau and instead detected DYRK1A-phosphorylated Tau, raising doubt about its phospho-epitope specificity.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The pSer409 Tau antibody was tested against a recombinant unphosphorylated Tau ladder and reacted weakly with the unphosphorylated protein, indicating imperfect phospho-specificity by a recombinant (non-genetic) control.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The rabbit anti-KOR antibody KT2 gave staining in brain sections that was abolished by pre-adsorption with the antigen peptide; it was not tested in KOR-knockout mice.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The rabbit anti-KOR antibody KOR1 gave staining that was blocked by the KOR(366-380) antigen peptide in brain sections and transfected cells; no knockout control was performed.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The anti-dynorphin-A antibody (Peninsula) gave results broadly concordant with other anti-dynorphin antibodies, but no knockout or knockdown control was used to confirm its specificity.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.approach: knockout RUN but signal not lost
cases.methods: The anti-TRPM6 antibody ACC-046 (Alomone) was tested in a conditional Trpm6-knockout mouse, but the staining pattern did not differ between wildtype and knockout tissue; the manufacturer reported only blocking-peptide validation.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The anti-Ntrk1 antibody AB-N03 had specificity previously reported in Ntrk1-mutant mice; in this study the authors could not reproduce that result — bands were unchanged between wildtype and Ntrk1-knockout samples.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The anti-phospho-Ntrk1 (Y490) antibody 9141 (Cell Signaling) was used on the basis of the manufacturer datasheet and a prior report in rat brain lysates; no in-study genetic control confirmed its specificity.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: A commercial anti-GABARAP antibody detected GABARAP by immunoblot but showed pronounced non-specific staining in GABARAP-knockout cells by immunofluorescence, so it was not confirmed specific in that application.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The rat monoclonal anti-GABARAP antibody 15A11 had its specificity confirmed against purified recombinant GABARAP by ELISA and western blot, but was not tested in GABARAP-knockout cells.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The anti-LC3B antibody clone 5F10 was used as an autophagosome marker on the basis that it reliably detects LC3B and not other LC3 family members; no knockout control was shown.

cases.label: not_reported
cases.methods: An anti-FLAG antibody (Sigma F7425) was used to detect FLAG-tagged KOR; no specificity validation of the anti-FLAG antibody itself was described.

cases.label: not_reported
cases.methods: A mouse monoclonal anti-beta-actin antibody (Sigma A5441) was used as a loading control; no specificity validation was described.

cases.label: not_reported
cases.methods: An anti-tyrosine-hydroxylase antibody (Millipore MAB318) was used as a procedural control for the staining workflow; no specificity validation of the antibody was described.
